\section{Conclusion}
In this paper, we propose a global and local attention mechanism for relation classification, which enhances global attention by adding local attention. To localize potential key words, we also propose hard localization and soft localization for local attention.
Result on Semeval 2010 Task 8 shows that under the same feature, our method outperforms previous attention methods for relation classification. Detailed analysis proves that attention becomes more reasonable and robust.
